config.name: Keys in use (all databases)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, max(Value) AS keys FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis_db_keys' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Memory used (MB)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(max(Value) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS used_mb FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis_memory_used_bytes' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Commands per minute
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(max(Value) - min(Value), 0) AS commands FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'redis_commands_processed_total' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Cache hit rate (%)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(100 * maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_hits_total') / greatest(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_hits_total') + maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'redis_keyspace_misses_total'), 1), 2) AS hit_pct FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('redis_keyspace_hits_total', 'redis_keyspace_misses_total') GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Connected and blocked clients
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS gauge, max(Value) AS clients FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('redis_connected_clients', 'redis_blocked_clients') GROUP BY ts, gauge ORDER BY ts

config.name: Evicted and expired keys
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS counter, max(Value) AS total FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('redis_evicted_keys_total', 'redis_expired_keys_total', 'redis_rejected_connections_total') GROUP BY ts, counter ORDER BY ts

config.name: Persistence and error state
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT MetricName AS metric, max(Value) AS value FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('redis_rdb_last_bgsave_status', 'redis_aof_last_write_status', 'redis_aof_enabled', 'redis_uptime_in_seconds') AND ServiceName = 'redis' GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric
